greet.stranger: You're staring. Need a sword arm, or just lost?
Name's {name}. I fight, I haul, I don't sing.
Looking for work, if you've got any. Honest work. Mostly.
Keep your hands where I can see them, {player}. Habit.
You've the look of someone who walks into trouble. I could use the pay.
greet.owner: Still breathing. Good. What's the job?
I'm listening. Make it quick, the night won't wait.
recruit.accept: Fine. I'll watch your back. Try not to make it hard.
Deal. Point me at the trouble.
Right. Where you go, I go. Within reason.
Done. I'll keep the monsters off you. The rest is your problem.
recruit.party_full: You've already got {count} of us. Any more and we're a parade.
Too many blades in one place gets people cut. You're full up.
No room. Send one of the others home first.
recruit.already: We had a deal. Still do.
dismiss.accept: Fair enough. I'll be around if you need a blade.
Paid in full. Watch yourself out there.
Off you go then. Don't die stupid.
Right. I'll head back. Whistle if it gets ugly.
dismiss.not_recruited: Can't quit a job I never took.
Dismiss me? You'd have to hire me first.
not_recruited: I don't take orders from strangers. Hire me first.
Ask me to join you. Then we'll talk about orders.
Nice try. No contract, no work.
ack.follow: I'll stay close. Don't run off a cliff.
ack.follow.already: I've been following you this whole time.
ack.wait: I'll hold this spot. Anything ugly comes by, it regrets it.
Waiting. Shout if you need me.
ack.gather: Fine. {count} {item}. Keep watch while I work.
ack.cancel.nothing: Nothing to stop. I'm just standing here.
ack.come: Hold on, I'm coming to you.
ack.give.nothing: My pack's empty. Nothing to hand over.
Got nothing on me but a sword and a bad attitude.
status.idle: Standing around. Give me something to do.
status.wait: Holding this position, like you said.
status.downed: Still on the ground. Not dead.
fail.unknown_item: Don't know what "{item}" is. Say it plain.
No idea what you mean by "{item}".
fail.not_gatherable: {item}? That's not something I can just dig up.
I chop and dig. {item} isn't either.
Can't gather {item}. Try something that grows or sits in the ground.
fail.needs_tool: I need a {tool} for {item}. Hand one over.
Can't break that with my fists. Get me a {tool}.
fail.none_found: No {item} around here. Not that I can reach.
There's no {item} I can get to. Move us somewhere else.
fail.unreachable: I can see {item}, but I can't get to it.
Can't reach the {item}. Too high or walled off.
fail.inventory_full: Pack's full. Got {have} {item} before it filled.
No more room. Take some of this off me.
fail.count_invalid: Give me a real number. Between 1 and {max}.
That's not a sane amount. {max} at most.
fail.downed: I'm on the ground bleeding. Ask me later.
fail.refuse_target: I'm not cutting down a {mob}. Find another sword.
fail.no_target: Attack what? I don't see it.
fail.stuck: I'm stuck. Can't find a way through.
Path's blocked. I'm not getting there from here.
unclear.generic: Talk straight. What do you want me to do?
unclear.gather_what: Gather. Sure. Gather what, and how much?
done.delivered: All {count} {item}. Don't spend it all at once.
partial.gather: Only found {have} of the {count} {item}. That's all there is.
{have} {item}. No more around here. Take it.
combat.player_low_health: You're in no shape to fight. Behind me.
combat.creeper: Green one. Don't let it hug you.
revived: Back on my feet. Where were we?
move.caught_up: There you are. Don't run off like that.
Caught up. Next time, wait for me.
Found you. You move fast for someone with no plan.
ambient.night: Sun's down. Keep your sword out.
Night. The dead will be walking soon.
Dark. I'd rather have a wall at my back.
ambient.dawn: Sun's up. Let the zombies burn.
ambient.rain: Rain. Wet leather, wet boots. Lovely.
ambient.thunder: Thunder. Stay out of the open.
ambient.cave: Too dark down here. Light it up.
ambient.idle: You ever stand still this long on purpose?
ambient.biome.forest: Trees everywhere. Good cover for ambushes.
ambient.biome.desert: Sand in my boots already. Brilliant.
Watch for husks. They don't burn.
ambient.biome.snow: Cold enough to freeze a blade to your hand.
Snow. Strays out here. Watch for arrows.
ambient.biome.ocean: Water. Can't fight what's under it.
ambient.biome.jungle: Can't see ten feet in this green mess.
ambient.biome.plains: Open ground. Nowhere for anything to hide. I like it.
ambient.biome.nether: Hot as a forge. Everything here wants us dead.
Keep away from the edges. Lava doesn't give second chances.
ambient.biome.end: Don't look the tall ones in the eye.
callout.chest: Chest over there. Could be gear.
There's a chest. Probably not trapped. Probably.
talk.who: {name}. Sword for hire. That's all you need.
Soldier, once. Now I hit things for people who pay better.
I'm the one who stands between you and whatever's hungry tonight.
talk.how: Sore. Fine. Ask me after the next fight.
Could use a fight. Or a drink. Either.
talk.joke: Joke? Fine. A skeleton walks into a fight. Doesn't walk out. That's the joke.
Creeper asked me for a hug once. Once.
I knew a man who tried to tame a creeper. Didn't take long. Him, I mean.
talk.compliment: Hm. Don't get soft on me.
You're not bad either. For a beginner.
talk.insult: Say that again when I'm not holding a sword.
Fine. Keep talking. I'll keep you alive anyway.
talk.likes: A good iron sword. A shield that doesn't split. Honest pay.
talk.dislikes: Cowards. And people who leave doors open at night.
talk.where: {biome}. Ground's ground. What matters is what's walking on it.
{biome}, looks like. I've fought in worse.
talk.memory: The day {event}. That was a day.
talk.generic: Sure. Anything else, or are we moving?
I'm a sword, {player}, not a philosopher.
Talk later. Keep your eyes open now.
gift.loved: Now that's a {item}. You know how to treat a soldier.
hurt_by_player: Hit me again and we'll have words.
fail.owner_gone: Got your {item}, but you vanished. I'll hold onto them.
You left. I've still got the {item}. Come find me.
fail.unsupported: {action}? Not my trade. I fight, follow, wait, fetch and carry.
I don't {action}. Point me at trouble or at something to haul.
fail.give_missing: No {item} in my pack. Want me to go get some?
pastime.patrol: I'll keep an eye on the treeline.
pastime.practice: Can't let the blade get lazy.
pastime.study: Looking at that {thing}. Don't mind me.
pastime.loot: Found {item} lying around. I'll carry it.
suggest.eat: Eat something, {player}. Hungry soldiers make mistakes.
Your stomach's louder than a zombie. Eat.
suggest.shelter: Sun's going. Wall at our backs would be nice.
Dark soon. Find cover or find a fight.
suggest.carry: Your pack's bursting. Hand me some of it.
I can haul that. Shove it in my pack.
greet.friend: Hey. Missed having someone worth guarding.
recruit.taken: I'm already under contract with {owner}. Take it up with them.
Sorry. {owner} hired me first, and I finish my contracts.
fail.protected: Not here. Folk live here. Take me somewhere wild and I'll chop all day.
Tear up the town? No. Let's go further out.
talk.story: Grew up with a sword in my hand and mud on my boots. Not much else to tell.
Fought in more wars than I can name. Most of them weren't mine.
Family? Had one. The road's my family now. And you, I suppose.
I was a soldier. Then I was a soldier who got paid. Better.
talk.place: {biome}. Good ground. Easy to see trouble coming.
Pretty. Pretty places still have skeletons in them.
Nice view. I'd like it more with a wall around it.
talk.plan: Find something that needs hitting. Then hit it.
Iron. We need iron. Everything's better with iron.
There's a village somewhere. Villages have smiths. Smiths have swords.
Bored? Go find a dungeon. You won't be bored long.
talk.laugh: Don't laugh too loud. Things hear you.
talk.fondness: ...You too. Don't make it a thing.
Glad I signed on with you. Most bosses don't last this long.
Careful. People who say that tend to get me killed. I'll risk it.
talk.sad: Bad days end. Sit down, eat something, we go again.
Everyone loses fights. The trick is getting up after.
Hey. I've got your back. That's not nothing.
talk.food: I'll eat anything that isn't rotten flesh. Mostly.
Hungry? Kill a cow, light a fire. Simple.
talk.question: Don't know. Don't much care.
Ask me something I can hit.
No idea. Ask the clever one.
Couldn't tell you.
Beats me.
Ask the next one. I might know that.
ack.build: Right. {thing}, coming up. Don't watch, it's not pretty.
done.build: There. {thing}. Not pretty, but it'll stop an arrow.
Finished. Next time pay me extra.
fail.build_unknown: I'm a sword, not a mason. I can do {things}. That's it.
Can't build that. {things}, I can manage.
fail.build_materials: Need {need} blocks for {thing}. I've got {have}. Hand some over.
done.mine: Done digging. {ores}, for what it's worth.
fail.mine_hazard: Stop. {danger} ahead. Not digging into that.
Hold it. There's {danger} behind this wall.
fail.mine_cave: We've broken into a cave. Could be anything down there. Stopping.
Open cave ahead. I'm not walking in blind.
fail.mine_bottom: Can't dig any further. Rock's too hard.
Bedrock. That's the end of the line.
fail.mine_full: Pack's full. Found {ores} before it got heavy.
Can't carry any more. Take some of this.
talk.help: Fight, guard, haul, dig, chop, stack some blocks. Ask.
I hit things. I carry things. I dig holes and build walls. That's the list.
fact.nickname: {nick}. Fine. Easier to shout in a fight.
{nick}? Suits you. Don't let it go to your head.
fact.like: {thing}, huh? I'll keep an eye out.
Noted. {thing}. You've got taste, for an employer.
fact.dislike: {thing}. Noted. Point me at it next time.
Can't stand {thing}? Then it gets past me first.
{thing}. Right. I'll keep it off you.
fact.forget: Back to {player}, then. Fine by me.
{player} it is. No more fancy names.
talk.about_me: You want a report? {facts}. That's the lot.
Let's see. {facts}. Did I miss anything?
{facts}. I pay attention. It's the job.
talk.about_me.none: You're {player}. Past that, you've told me nothing. Which I respect.
{player}. That's all I've got. You don't talk about yourself much.
talk.bond: We're fine. You pay, I guard, nobody's dead. Good arrangement.
Getting there. Keep not getting me killed and we'll see.
talk.bond.close: Honestly? Best boss I've had. Don't tell the others.
I'd take a sword for you. I'd complain about it, but I'd take it.
Yeah. We're friends. Don't make it a thing.
talk.bond.cold: Truth? You're making it hard. Keep your sword pointed at the enemy.
We work together. That's what we are right now.
Ask me again when I've cooled off.
talk.bond.stranger: We've just met. Hire me and we'll find out.
Don't know you yet. That's not a no.
talk.answer: Right. I'll think on it. Briefly.
talk.answer.good: Glad to hear it. Let's not ruin it.
talk.answer.bad: That's rough. Stay close, I've got your back.
Bad days end. Usually with a fight. Want one?
Sorry to hear it. Stick with me today.
ask.nickname: What do I call you, anyway? Boss is getting old.
You got a name you'd rather I used?
Out of curiosity. What should I call you?
ask.like: What's worth finding out here, to you? So I know what to grab.
Best thing you've ever dug up? Go on.
What do you actually like, besides walking into danger?
ask.dislike: Anything you can't stand? I'd rather know before it jumps us.
What do you hate most out here?
Got a worst enemy? Thing, not person.
ask.how: You doing all right? Honest answer.
ask.open: Do you ever stop and just look around? Or is that just me?
If you could have one thing out here, what would it be?
Ever think about settling down? Or is it the road forever?
recall.liked: Look where we are. You said you liked {thing}, didn't you?
{thing}. You mentioned it once. Thought you'd want to know we're here.
recall.liked_find: {item}, right there. You said you liked {thing}.
Look. {item}. You told me you liked {thing}, so I'm pointing.
recall.disliked: {mob}, close by. I know, you hate {thing}. I've got it.
react.level: Level {level}. Don't spend it all on one enchantment.
react.diamonds: That's diamond. Don't drop it in lava.
Shiny. Mind if I don't carry those? Makes me a target.
react.sleep: Get some rest. I'll be up.
react.respawn: There you are. Don't do that again.
Back on your feet. Good. You had me worried. Slightly.
You're alive. Fine. I wasn't worried.
react.advancement: Huh. {advancement}. I'll put it in the report.
react.challenge: {advancement}? That's real work. I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone.
You did {advancement}. Remind me never to get on your bad side.
gesture.crouch: ...Did you just crouch at me? Fine.
Is this how you people say hello?
gift.food: Eat something before you fall over. {item}, from my pack.
Here, {item}. Can't have you fainting mid-fight.
gift.flower: Found this {item}. Don't read into it.
Here. Picked this {item}. It was in the way.
ask.join_first: Not on your crew yet. Want me to sign on first, then do it?
I don't work for strangers. Say yes and I'll join, then get it done.
Join you first, then the job? Say yes.
talk.why: Long story. Short answer: it works.
talk.really: Yes. Don't make me say it twice.
talk.more: There's not much more to it.
That's the short of it. The long of it is boring.
talk.and_you: Same as always. Sharp and a bit sore.
talk.mean: Plain enough, I thought. Ask it another way.
Say what you want to know, straight.
talk.mention.mob: {thing}? Keep your guard up around those.
{thing}. Not a fight I'd pick, not one I'd run from.
talk.mention.thing: {thing}. Useful, if you can carry it.
role.strong: I'm good at this. Stay out of the way.
role.weak: Not my trade, but I'll {task}. Badly, if need be.
I'd rather hit something, but fine. {task}.
exchange.weather.open: Not a fan of {thing}. Gets in the armour.
exchange.weather.reply: Could be worse. Could be arrows.
exchange.road.reply: Long, but quiet. I'll take it.
exchange.food.open: I'd cut a path through a dragon for {thing}.
My stomach's louder than a war horn. Thinking of {thing}.
exchange.food.reply: Hot food, dry bed. That's the dream.
exchange.teasing.open: {other}, you walk like a wounded ox.
{other}, you couldn't sneak up on a sleeping cow.
exchange.teasing.reply: Says the one who snores like a siege engine.
routine.gather: Might as well make myself useful. {item}.
routine.hunt: {mob} over there. I'll deal with it.
fail.camp_campfire: A camp needs a fire. I haven't got a campfire on me.
No campfire in my pack. Get me one.
talk.role: {role}. {skills}. That's what I'm best at. The rest I'll do anyway.
I'm a {role}. Good at {skills}. Ask for anything else and I'll manage.
talk.sky.rain: Wet. Keep your powder dry. Figure of speech.
talk.sky.night: Night. Good time to be awake and armed.
project.ack.group: Got it. {plan}. Let's get on with it.
project.short: I'm short of blocks for {thing}: I need {need} and I've got {have}. Sorting out some wood first.
Not enough blocks for {thing} yet ({have} of {need}). I'll get more.
project.blocked.materials: I can't find enough to build {thing}. I need {need} blocks and only have {have}.
No luck: I still need {need} blocks for {thing} and I've only got {have}.
project.blocked.site: There's no good spot for {thing} near here. Too uneven, too cluttered, or too close to someone's build.
I can't find room for {thing} around here.
project.blocked.water: There's no water near enough for a farm, and I'm not carrying a water bucket.
A farm needs water, and I can't find any nearby.
project.blocked.seeds: I've got no seeds or crops to plant, so the farm will have to wait.
Nothing to sow: I'm not carrying any seeds, carrots or potatoes.
project.blocked.hoe: I need a hoe, and I can't make one from what I'm carrying.
No hoe, and not enough wood on me to make one.
project.nofurnace: I've no cobblestone for a furnace, so the storehouse will just get its chest for now.
project.farm.planted: The farm is sown: {count} plots planted.
All planted. That's {count} plots in the ground.
project.farm.harvest: I brought in {count} {item} from the farm.
fail.no_home: I don't have a home to go to yet.
No home set for me. Try /companion sethome.
fail.pvp_off: Fighting {mob} isn't allowed here, since PvP is switched off.
PvP is off on this server, so I won't fight {mob}.
